itinerary.cal: Climb July-September; the route sees little traffic so expect some lichen, and there is no reliable water at or above Burgundy Col.

days.note: Approach Burgundy Col, then scramble down and around the north face to the NE Buttress start. Eight pitches of sustained 5.10 climbing on a lightly-traveled, sometimes lichenated line demand careful route-finding. Most parties treat this as a full, committing day and finish by downclimbing or linking into the standard North Face rappel line.
days.title: Car-to-car: NE Buttress (Ultramega OK)

schedule.label: Leave the pullout
schedule.detail: Cross Early Winter Creek and start up the climbers' trail.

schedule.label: Bench camp (6,460 ft)
schedule.detail: Last reliable water; tank up here, especially late season.

schedule.label: Burgundy Col (7,770 ft)
schedule.detail: Scramble down and around the north face to the NE Buttress base.

schedule.label: Start climbing
schedule.detail: 8 pitches of sustained 5.10, ~900 ft of climbing.

schedule.label: Top out
schedule.detail: Downclimb or link into the standard North Face rap line.

schedule.label: Back at car
schedule.detail: 5-rappel descent plus the hike out from the Col.

days.objective: Send the NE Buttress (5.10c/d, 8 pitches) and summit Burgundy Spire

itinerary.totalNote: A long single day for strong 5.10 parties, roughly 13-15 hrs car-to-car, with real route-finding on a lightly traveled line — not a route to underestimate.
